footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Hudson Pacific Properties: includes a $273K income tax benefit, $20.1M from preferred dividends. The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 1.3% to $831M in 2025. Gross margin was 48.5%, versus 46.1% a year earlier, and the operating loss narrowed to $44.6M from $45.9M.
The net loss widened to $572M, or −$12.81 per share, from $364M. Operating cash flow was $121M and free cash flow $121M, versus $165M; Hudson Pacific Properties returned $351K through dividends.
